newsitem.title: USA: Alanco says was profitable in December.
newsitem.headline: Alanco says was profitable in December.

text.p: Alanco Environmental Resources Corp said Monday it was profitable for the month of December, completing the first stage of its turnaround strategy.
It said Fry Guy revenues soared from $92,500 in October, to $242,000 in November, to $572,000 in December.
It said shareholders were told at the annual meeting that Alanco expects higher revenues as the Fry Guy program continues with its push into the independent retail market.

The Fry Guy Integrated Food Marketing Program supplies a patented, self-ventilating fryer in a convenient counter-top unit that requires little shelf space and operates on 110-volt power. Under the private label SGT. FRY, Fry Guy provides end users with finger food products in conjunction with prominent food suppliers.
